title: Maximal
brief: remove a part and a known object remains; add one and the four states break
about: Seven parts make the obligatory, and taking any one away leaves an object already known: without origins a meet of the lattice, without rests a cell nothing reaches, without a ceiling the lattice itself, without an epoch a timeless set of claims, without resolution a flat map, without ids a log that cannot take back, without join a ceiling that only narrows.
